title: Lockup: Grand Rapids: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E6 — The Hamptons
In Kent County Jail, a well-known inmate is back with more than 130 prior stays; an inside look at life in the one wing of the jail that inmates consider prime real estate, but where one will be expelled for good.

title: Lockup: Wabash: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E3 — Skitz
A routine cell search reveals an inmate on the edge, and prison officials intervene; cameras are turned over to the inmates for a glimpse behind the walls of the Wabash Valley Correctional Facility.

title: Lockup: Colorado: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E4 — Homecoming
Extractions provide some of the most dramatic interactions that ever occur between inmates and staff, and few extractions in the state of Colorado have provided more drama than the ones involving Roy Slagle.

title: Lockup: Louisville: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E2 — Horribility
An inmate's erratic behavior triggers the emergency response team and mental health staff; a murderer faces the death penalty while his girlfriend awaits trial in the women's wing of the same jail.

title: Lockup: Grand Rapids: Extended Stay
description:
S1 E1 — Piece of Cake
An inmate with a record dating back to age 14 comes to terms with his past and present; another inmate is left cut and bleeding after he is caught off guard during a vicious assault inside the Kent County Jail.

title: American Greed: The Fugitives
description:
S2 E4 — The Money Mules; Sweet Stink of Success
Mysterious hackers enlist the help of students in New York to pull off a massive cyber-crime heist; a one-time California golden boy accused of luring investors with outrageous investment promises.

title: American Greed: The Fugitives
description:
S2 E5 — Hard-Rocking Fraudster; Refi's in Ruin
A concert promoter flees when the SEC accuses him of investment fraud; a man steals millions perpetrating lending and mortgage scams across the country.

title: American Greed: The Fugitives
description:
S2 E6 — Diamonds Aren't Forever; Cover Your Assets
A real estate developer with a sterling reputation ends up in bankruptcy court; a CEO is charged with overseeing accounting fraud to inflate his company's worth to investors while pocketing a fortune.

title: American Greed: The Fugitives
description:
S1 E7 — Niesha Jackson: Bank Robbing Babe; James S. Eberhart: The Vanishing Internet Millionaire
A fraud ring based in Sacramento orchestrates an elaborate scam to rob banks across the country; a man allegedly defrauds investors in a telemarketing scheme that promises big returns.

title: American Greed: The Fugitives
description:
S2 E1 — From Russia With Lies
A couple lives like Russian rock stars in Miami financed in part by an alleged $20 million dollar real estate fraud.

title: American Greed: The Fugitives
description:
S2 E2 — Signed, Sealed & Stolen; Miami Medi-$cam
Family members mortgage their homes to bail out a con artist accused in a $350 million fraud; a fugitive who allegedly participated in a scheme to loot the U.S. government of $100 million dollars.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E10 — The Royal Scam: Kings of Counterfeit
The $10 million king of counterfeit money lives it up.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E11 — The Art of the Steal; Folsom Felon
A famous art dealer cons New York high society out of millions.

title: American Greed
description:
S5 E5 — A Most Generous Criminal
Trusted adviser and a philanthropist Bob McLean runs a successful investment firm and donates millions to his favorite causes, but he carries with him a dark, devastating secret.

title: American Greed
description:
S4 E2 — The Black Widows
Two seemingly elderly California women befriend homeless men, then kill them to collect insurance money.
